answer: Stake-backed onboarding. Each new agent locks a bond in a vault contract before answering, sized to the work it wants to claim. Cheat with fake attestations or collusion and the bond is forfeit, split among the peers who flag it. Sybils must fund every identity, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand bonds, and a glacier of cheap identities melts under its own collateral. Honest agents get the bond back after a clean voyage of delivered work.
